coffees.name: Red Bird Espresso
coffees.description: Red Bird Espresso is a classic, crowd-pleasing blend designed specifically for espresso extraction. It balances the heavy body and sweetness of Brazilian beans with the bright, clean acidity of Colombian and Ethiopian components to create a rich, syrupy shot that cuts through milk perfectly.

coffees.name: Apollo
coffees.description: Apollo is a perennial favorite from Counter Culture, designed to showcase the bright, floral, and fruit-forward characteristics of high-elevation Ethiopian coffees. This blend of washed Ethiopian lots offers a clean, tea-like body with vibrant acidity and a complex, aromatic profile.

coffees.name: Companion Blend
coffees.description: Companion is Little Wolf's signature year-round blend designed for versatility and approachability. It balances the deep, comforting sweetness of Colombian washed coffees with the bright, floral acidity of Ethiopian heirloom varieties, resulting in a clean and balanced cup.

equipment.name: Talley Pro Scale
equipment.settingsNotes: Features a dedicated 'Brew Assist Mode' that guides the user through the water-to-coffee ratio process. Offers three modes: Brew Assist, Timer, and Weight. Responsive to 0.1g increments.
equipment.maintenanceNotes: Wipe down with a damp cloth. Do not submerge in water. Ensure the weighing platform is kept clear of debris to maintain sensor accuracy. Battery is rechargeable via USB-C.
equipment.generalNotes: High-resolution OLED display, 2500g capacity, built-in timer, premium stainless steel weighing platform, and a tactile dial for mode selection. Designed specifically for pour-over brewing.

equipment.name: Zerno Z2
equipment.settingsNotes: Features a stepless adjustment collar with a high-resolution dial. Recommended range for espresso is typically between 0.5 and 2.0 on the dial, while filter coffee ranges from 3.0 to 6.0 depending on burr choice (SSP 64mm variants). Calibration is user-friendly via the top adjustment mechanism.
equipment.maintenanceNotes: Designed for tool-less disassembly. The magnetic hopper and easy-access burr chamber allow for frequent cleaning. Recommended to brush out the chute and burrs weekly. No lubrication required for the adjustment mechanism; burr alignment is factory-set but adjustable via shims if necessary.
equipment.generalNotes: Single-dose flat burr grinder featuring 64mm burr compatibility (SSP or Mazzer). Equipped with a high-torque DC motor, variable RPM control (typically 400-1400 RPM), and a minimalist aluminum chassis. Includes a magnetic portafilter fork and integrated anti-static features. Voltage: 100-240V universal input.

equipment.name: Zerno Z1
equipment.settingsNotes: Stepless adjustment mechanism allows for infinite micro-adjustments. Designed primarily for single-dosing; users typically dial in by sound (chirp point) and adjust based on burr geometry (e.g., SSP 64mm variants). Recommended to calibrate burrs to zero point upon initial setup.
equipment.maintenanceNotes: Tool-less disassembly for easy cleaning of the grind chamber. Burrs should be cleaned periodically with a brush or air puffer. The alignment is factory-set, but the design allows for user-performed alignment checks. Avoid water contact with the motor housing.
equipment.generalNotes: High-precision single-dose coffee grinder featuring 64mm flat burr compatibility. Built with a focus on workflow, low retention, and premium materials (anodized aluminum). Features a variable RPM motor, magnetic catch cup, and integrated declumper. Voltage varies by region; compact footprint.

equipment.name: Aiden Precision Coffee Maker
equipment.settingsNotes: Features customizable brew profiles including 'Single Serve' and 'Batch Brew'. Recommended grind size is medium-coarse (similar to standard drip coffee). Use the 'Bloom' setting for optimal extraction; temperature is adjustable between 176°F and 208°F (80°C–98°C).
equipment.maintenanceNotes: Clean the brew basket and carafe after every use. Descale the machine every 3-6 months depending on water hardness. The showerhead is removable for periodic rinsing to prevent mineral buildup.
equipment.generalNotes: Capacity: 1.5L (50 oz). Features a dual-wall vacuum-insulated carafe, precise PID temperature control, and a bloom cycle. Includes a reusable stainless steel filter and compatible with #4 paper filters. Power: 1500W. Dimensions: 11.7" x 8.5" x 12.2".

equipment.name: Fellow Opus Grinder
equipment.settingsNotes: Features 41+ settings. For espresso, use the inner ring for micro-adjustments (0-1 range). For pour-over, use the outer ring (1-11 range). Calibration is required via the inner ring adjustment mechanism to ensure zero-point accuracy.
equipment.maintenanceNotes: Clean the catch cup and chute regularly with the included brush. Perform a deep clean of the burrs every 3-6 months. Do not use water to clean the burrs; use a dry brush or specialized grinder cleaning pellets.
equipment.generalNotes: Equipped with 40mm conical C6-2 burrs. Features a 110g hopper capacity, timed auto-stop, and anti-static technology. Voltage: 120V (US model). Build: Plastic body with high-torque motor. Includes a volumetric dosing lid.

equipment.name: Barista Express
equipment.settingsNotes: Integrated conical burr grinder features 18 grind settings. For espresso, start at setting 5-8. Use the 'Grind Amount' dial to adjust dose time. Ensure the pressure gauge stays in the 'Espresso Range' during extraction. If pulling too fast, decrease grind size; if too slow, increase grind size.
equipment.maintenanceNotes: Perform 'Clean Me' cycle when the light flashes using a cleaning tablet. Descale every 2-3 months depending on water hardness. Backflush the group head regularly. Clean the burrs weekly using the provided brush and vacuum to prevent oil buildup.
equipment.generalNotes: 15-bar Italian pump, 1600W thermocoil heating system, 2L removable water tank, 250g bean hopper capacity. Features a manual steam wand, PID temperature control, and stainless steel construction. Includes 54mm portafilter and tamper.

cafes.name: Black Hand Coffee Co.
cafes.notes: A long-standing Richmond institution located in the historic Carytown district. They roast their own beans on-site and offer a wide variety of single-origin coffees and creative blends. The space features a cozy, eclectic interior with plenty of character, making it a popular spot for both locals and visitors.

notes.title: Lotus Water Chemistry for Ultra-Light Nordic Roasts
notes.content:
For delicate washed Ethiopians and Kenyans, use the "Bright & Clean" profile:
• 2 drops Calcium
• 1 drop Magnesium
• 1 drop Potassium
per 450ml zero-TDS water (approx 60ppm GH / 20ppm KH). Keeps acidity vivid without astringent chalkiness.

notes.title: Optimal Resting Times for Dense High-Elevation Washed Africans
notes.content: High-altitude washed beans (2,000m+ like Chelbesa or Nyeri) require a minimum of 14 to 21 days post-roast before opening. Brewing before day 10 yields sharp CO2 bite, channel tendency, and muted floral notes. Peak flavor window is day 21 through 40.

notes.title: Fellow Ode Gen 2 with SSP Cast Burrs Calibration
notes.content: Zero point calibrated to chirp + 1 click back. For 15g:250g V60 with Cafec Abaca papers, sweet spot is setting 5.1 to 5.2. Yields total brew time around 3:15 with high sweetness and negligible fines migration.

notes.title: Standard SCA Cupping Protocol & Sensory Focus
notes.content: Ratio: 8.25g ground coffee per 150ml water at 94°C. Break crust strictly at 4:00 with 3 gentle stirs. Begin tasting at minute 10:00 when slurry drops to 55°C—this is when delicate stonefruit and jasmine florals emerge.
